copy.intro: A four door Ford sedan with a 3.5 L V6 and automatic transmission, seating five for city errands and longer highway drives.
good_for: Family outings for up to five

faq.question: How many people fit in the Taurus?
faq.answer: The 2014 Ford Taurus SEL has 5 seats and four doors.

faq.question: Is the Taurus automatic?
faq.answer: Yes. It has an automatic transmission, a 3.5 L V6 engine and front-wheel drive.

faq.question: How do I get the Taurus?
faq.answer: Collect it at our location at no charge, or have it delivered to your address. Delivery is $75.

faq.question: How many kilometres are included each day?
faq.answer: 200 km a day are included. Extra kilometres are $0.35 each.

copy.intro: A black 2023 Ford Maverick pickup with all-wheel drive and a 2.0 L engine, ready for hauling, errands and everyday driving.

faq.question: How many people fit in the Maverick?
Does the Maverick have all-wheel drive?
faq.answer: Yes. This Maverick is all-wheel drive and runs on gas with a 2.0 L engine.

faq.question: Which safety features does it list?
faq.answer: Automatic emergency braking, forward collision alert, a backup camera and automatic high beams.

faq.question: Can the Maverick be delivered?
faq.answer: Yes. Collect it at our location at no charge, or have it delivered to your address for $75.
